caption:
Mr Turtle is teaching this term, and a few weeks in, his calves and back already know it.

Standing at the board, bending over low desks, carrying tubs of books and marking hunched at home all add up. Calves, lower back, neck and shoulders usually feel it first.

Remedial massage can ease that tightness and help you feel less stiff by Friday. It works well alongside small habits: crouch beside students, rest a foot on a low step when standing, and mark at a table.

Pain that wakes you, spreads down a limb or comes with numbness is worth a physio or GP assessment instead. Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio can help through term one. Book online via the link in bio 🐢

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
